title: Reject illegal actions without changing the game
description:
As a learner, I want illegal actions refused by the engine, so that no hand can ever reach an impossible state.

An illegal action submitted to the engine is rejected with an error and leaves the game state unchanged. Illegal includes acting out of turn, a wrong bet amount, raising on a capped street, and folding when no bet is faced (check is free, Q-45).

## Requirements covered
- REQ-017 (Must): Legal actions only — The engine shall accept only legal actions for the player to act, and the Table screen shall offer the user only the legal actions with their exact amounts.

Covers: REQ-017

## Notes
Return a typed result (ok/error code) rather than throwing so UI and playtest handle it the same way.

Plan key: E01-S11 · Dream: limit-holdem-trainer

acceptanceCriteria.text: Given it is seat 3's turn, When seat 5 submits any action, Then the engine returns an out-of-turn error and the state is byte-identical to before [REQ-017.4]
Given preflop at $4/$8, When a player submits a bet or raise of any amount other than $4, Then the engine returns an error and the state is unchanged [REQ-017.4]
Given a capped street, When a player submits a raise, Then the engine returns an error and the state is unchanged [REQ-017.4]
Given no bet is facing the player to act, When that player submits fold, Then the engine returns an error and the state is unchanged [REQ-017.4]
Given 100,000 random game states, When an illegal action is injected into each, Then every injection is rejected and the state is byte-identical [REQ-017.4]
